new_news.headline: Renewable fuel from food waste: Darling Ingredients transforms agricultural waste into sustainable products
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients positions itself as a leader in converting food waste and animal byproducts into renewable fuels and specialty products, with operations processing over 100 million metric tons of supply globally, emphasizing its role as an essential service for rendering and renewable fuel production.

new_news.headline: New Way and Hyzon unveil first hydrogen fuel cell refuse truck
new_news.summary: North America's first hydrogen fuel cell-powered electric refuse truck unveiled at WasteExpo at the Las Vegas Convention Center, following a February joint development agreement between New Way and Hyzon to develop zero-emission refuse collection vehicles.

new_news.headline: Cemetery expansion, Wastewater Treatment Plant upgrades up for votes in Erving
new_news.summary: Erving, Massachusetts voters will decide on a $1 million capital project to update the secondary clarifiers at the town-owned Erving Center Wastewater Treatment Plant, which were installed in the 1970s. The town contracts with Erving Industries Inc. to operate the plant under a cost-sharing agreement.

new_news.headline: Top Electric & CNG Garbage Trucks for Fleet Managers (2026)
new_news.summary: The 2026 refuse truck market is the first year in history where electric and natural gas options compete directly with diesel on cost, range, and operational fitness for waste collection routes, with analysis of Mack LR Electric, Peterbilt 520EV, and other alternatives.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Safety-Kleen Segment Drives Q1 Profitability with Higher Charge-for-Oil Pricing
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors Safety-Kleen Sustainable Solutions segment reported adjusted EBITDA increase of 17% to $33M despite lower revenue, driven by higher charge-for-oil pricing and improved base oil prices. The company collected 53M gallons of waste oil in Q1, maintaining strong re-refinery utilization. PFAS-related business highlighted as growing 25-35% in 2026 vs. prior 20% growth rate.

new_news.headline: Waste Collection Route Optimization: Beyond GPS Tracking
new_news.summary: Analysis of AI-powered waste collection route optimization emphasizing demand-responsive collection models, real-time fill-level monitoring, and predictive routing that adapts to dynamic waste generation patterns and prevents costly emergency dispatches.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Expands Field Service Footprint; Plans 10 New Branches in 2026
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors opened 18 field service branches in 2025 and plans to open 10 more in 2026. Field services revenue grew 7% in Q1, supported by emergency response work including a single large-scale event generating ~$10M in revenue. Company exited Q1 with March revenue approximately 10% higher YoY, providing momentum for continued expansion.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q1 2026 EPS Beats Estimates; Company Reports Strong Core Ingredients EBITDA Growth
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 EPS of $0.83, significantly surpassing analyst expectations of $0.59 (41% beat). Revenue slightly missed at $1.55B vs. forecast $1.56B. The company reported combined adjusted EBITDA of $406.8M (up 108% YoY) driven by Diamond Green Diesel performance and core ingredients segment recovery. FY2026 guidance includes revenue of approximately $6.54B and Q2 core ingredients EBITDA of $260-275M.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q1 2026 Earnings Call: Record Q1 Margins and Continued M&A Activity
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental highlighted record Q1 adjusted EBITDA margin of 29.1%, up 180 basis points YoY. Announced proposed SECURE Waste acquisition expected in H2 2026, with Secure's 2026 revenue expected at $1.5-1.6B. Operational synergies identified at $25-50M above base SGA savings of $25M. Management targets 3.0x-3.5x leverage through cycle.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Completes Eight Acquisitions Including Frontier Waste Solutions; Raises 2026 Guidance
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental completed eight acquisitions year-to-date, including Frontier Waste Solutions in Texas. These deals add $425-450M in annualized revenue and further densify GFL's North American network. Proposed SECURE Waste acquisition expected in H2 2026 is described as incremental to current outlook. Net leverage reached 3.6x despite positive operational metrics.

new_news.headline: Queen Sirikit National Convention Center partners with PTTGC to convert used cooking oil into SAF under 'From Kitchen to Creation' initiative
new_news.summary: Queen Sirikit National Convention Center launched the 'From Kitchen to Creation' initiative with PTT Global Chemical, collecting used cooking oil from on-site food operations and converting it into SAF, diverting over 68,000 kilograms of food waste and UCO from landfill in 2025.
